title: Recipe
description: Cooking recipe with instructions, ingredients, timing, nutritional information, difficulty level, and author details. Used for recipe websites, cooking apps, and meal planning platforms.

title.description: Recipe title or name (e.g., Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies, Beef Stroganoff)

description.description: Brief description of the recipe, its origin, or what makes it special

cuisine.description: Cuisine type or origin (e.g., Italian, French, Asian, American)

category.description: Recipe category (e.g., appetizer, main course, dessert, breakfast, snack)

difficulty.description: Difficulty level (e.g., easy, medium, hard, expert)

prep_time.description: Preparation time in minutes before cooking begins

servings.description: Number of servings the recipe yields

rating.description: Average user rating, typically on a scale of 1-5

author.description: Full name of the recipe author or creator

image.description: URL to the recipe image or photo

created_at.description: Timestamp when the recipe was created or published
